# ADR-0001: Cloud provider

**Status:** accepted · **Date:** 2026-11-14 · generated by `new-project`; edit freely, it is yours now.

## Context

This project starts with no cloud infrastructure.

## Decision

**Decision:** none

## Consequences

No `infra/terraform/` tree and no `terraform.yml` workflow. Re-run the matrix below when hosting is needed.

## Alternatives considered

| Criterion | azure | gcp | aws |
|---|---|---|---|
| Identity model | Entra ID; managed identity everywhere; Postgres can be Entra-only | Google identity; service accounts; IAM DB auth for Cloud SQL | IAM; roles for compute; IAM DB auth for RDS |
| Managed Postgres | Flexible Server | Cloud SQL | RDS / Aurora |
| Container hosting | Container Apps | Cloud Run | App Runner / ECS Fargate |
| Secret store | Key Vault (RBAC) | Secret Manager | Secrets Manager / SSM |
| Document AI | Document Intelligence | Document AI | Textract |
| Cost floor for a small API + DB | low tens of USD/month | low tens; Cloud Run scales to zero | low tens; App Runner scales to zero |
| Terraform provider maturity | azurerm, mature | google, mature | aws, most mature |
| Pick it when | the organization already lives in Microsoft 365 / Entra | data and ML tooling (BigQuery, Vertex) matter most | breadth of services or existing AWS skills dominate |
